assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded CPT 93229
The purpose of the mobile cardiac telemetry was to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The purpose of the mobile cardiac telemetry was to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The mobile cardiac telemetry was medically necessary to evaluate the patient's known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
